title: Gap row BP-bac81f87 names a _gaps.md entry that is no longer open and its pack is good, and pool check never judges a gap row's route
goal: Every gap row of bench_pool.csv names an open _gaps.md entry (kbfacts.OPEN_GAP) and its pack routes to web; pool check names a gap row whose entry has closed or narrowed or whose pack does not route to web

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import bench_pool as b;bad=[r['id'] for r in b.read_csv(b.PUBLIC_FILE) if r['kind']=='gap' and b.scenario_pack(r['question'])[0]!='web'];print(bad);sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)

notes: Overlaps draft BG-sclw54q6 (the same row BP-bac81f87); this one adds that pool check judges no gap row's route or openness. Merge the two at triage. Merged from BG-sclw54q6 “Bench pool gap row BP-bac81f87 names a _gaps.md entry a Narrowed note now closes, and still expects the web route” at the 2026-10-13 draft triage: Same row BP-bac81f87, same fix; BG-viwywxml is broader (adds that pool check judges a gap row's route and openness) and its notes ask for the merge. Repro still exits 1; pool check does not name the row. Its goal: No stored gap row of kb/public/_retrieval/bench_pool.csv names a _gaps.md entry that kbfacts.OPEN_GAP reads as closed: the repro exits 0, and a pool gap row stale this way fails a check at the landing that closes its entry, not at a later review Its repro: {"run": ["python3", "-c", "import sys,re,hashlib;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import kbfacts,bench_pool;T=open('kb/public/_gaps.md',encoding='utf-8').read();H={hashlib.sha1(re.sub(r'^(Still open|Narrowed, not closed):\\s*','',m.group(1)).strip(' .:*').encode()).hexdigest()[:8]:m.group(0) for m in re.finditer(r'^- \\*\\*(.+?)\\*\\*.*(?:\\n  .+)*',T,re.M)};bad=[r['id'] for r in bench_pool.load_pool(kinds={'gap'}) if kbfacts.OPEN_GAP.search(H.get(r['source'].split('#')[1],'Resolved'))];print('gap rows whose entry is closed:',bad);sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)"]} Its touches: kb/public/_retrieval/bench_pool.csv, _tools/bench_pool.py
